title: PTY session survives agent teardown
body: Retiring an agent leaves its PTY attached; the next spawn inherits stale output.

title: Wire labels overflow at low zoom
body: Labels longer than 24 characters run past their wire below 0.5 scale.

title: Replay skips the first envelope of a thread
body: The reader started at offset 1. Fixed by seeking to 0.

title: Mission Control Direct Message row click is a no-op
body: Chris clicked the first live lane row and no conversation opened.

title: Act-as-Chris verification sampled instead of clicking every changed interaction
body: Representative sampling passed while the first live click later failed.

title: Simultaneous mission spawns attach the same session ID to both durable Agent records
body: Two provider sessions were created but both durable rows attached the first session.

title: External envelopes lack durable sender and recipient Agent IDs
body: Externally registered sessions are not covered by roster-based durable identity stamping.

title: Pull mailboxes are reader-open
body: Any session can poll a named mailbox, so the journal alone cannot prove which session replied.

title: Mailbox-first routing can shadow a future same-name PTY
body: A durable mailbox is resolved before a later live terminal with the same name.

title: Externally registered sessions remain invisible in the Agents roster
body: The roster only projects backend-owned PTYs.

title: Dead runtime-only sessions are labelled retired
body: Exited sessions without a retirement transition render under an inaccurate retired label.

title: Messages and Mission Control can show different liveness for one person
body: Each surface derives liveness from a different fetch time.

title: Mission Control hero and Live Squad use stale thread context
body: The screen can claim zero live agents while three live rows are visible.

title: LIVE PRESENCES lists an exited agent while MEMBERS says live
body: Two liveness grammars contradict each other inside one panel.

title: One logical message renders twice
body: Queued and delivered copies of the same envelope both render.

title: Files appears to render a duplicate directory tree
body: Retracted after byte and source inspection proved the finding was a measurement double-count.

title: Mission Room shows a stale owner and status
body: Raw mission fields were not transitioned during the active run.

title: Status-label casing differs across surfaces
body: The same state renders with different casing in Mission Control and Messages.

title: Diagnostic rooms appear in live and archived lists
body: Diagnostic fixture rooms leaked into production-shaped data.

title: Same-name rows share conversation-keyed selection
body: Selecting one identity twin marks every row with the shared conversation key.

title: Message status counts do not reconcile
body: Queued pull-mailbox envelopes are missing from the visible status totals.

title: Hidden-files filter treats dot directories inconsistently
body: One dot directory remains visible while another follows the hidden toggle.

title: Agent working can appear for an external session without a runtime
body: A recency heuristic invents working state for a pull-only external session.

title: Room member picker excludes unverified external sessions
body: An idle external Chief cannot be invited after falling outside the live tier.

title: Too many yes-men in the chain — management layers approve the same thing without adding independent judgement
body: Each layer rubber-stamps the previous one; no seat is rewarded for disagreeing.

title: Plans and fixes often patch symptoms instead of fixing root cause
body: Patching bad engineering rather than proposing the proper fix.

title: No process for monitoring worker usage and tokens — oversight is manual only
body: Nobody notices a worker burning context until it hits the wall.

title: DM to an unregistered terminal chief session fails 404 and renders as failed in the Messages UI
body: No pre-registration fallback; the failure surfaces raw in the UI.

title: PROCESS GAP: act-as-Chris verification accepted sampling where the Contract required exhaustive clicking
body: Representative sampling passed the gate; the first live click by Chris failed.

title: Chief-Chris terminal back-and-forth has no journal path — DM lane shows registered-onward traffic only
body: Pre-registration terminal conversation is invisible to the DM lane.

title: Artifact store blocks with mission refs never join the Mission Room Evidence panel
body: Evidence panel only reads its own store; artifact blocks with mission refs are dropped.

title: Mission Room member rows render raw scratchpad store paths as provenance
body: Noisy and leaks local paths.

title: Mission decision refs are dangling-checked but never rendered as linked context in the Mission Room
body: Decisions exist on the mission record but the room never shows them.
